blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Multimodal deep search is moving from short queries to long-horizon investigations that continually acquire evidence. However, training such agents remains constrained by limited challenging training questions and insufficient process feedback.
  We introduce MMSearch-OPD, combining controllable data refinement with joint reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). Our Refine pipeline performs targeted expansion of reasoning chains derived from existing simple multimodal questions. Parameterized transformations control search depth and cross-modal evidence requirements while reusing existing image--question pairs. For training, answer rewards and lightweight behavior penalties guide RL, while the reward gap modulates token-level teacher guidance on imperfect student trajectories. An exponentially decaying distillation coefficient reduces teacher dependence as training proceeds.
  Experiments show gains from data refinement and further improvements from joint training after SFT, indicating stronger long-horizon multimodal deep search capabilities.
blocks.zh:
多式联运深度搜索正在从简短的查询转向持续获取证据的长期调查。 然而,培训这些工作人员仍然受到有限的挑战性培训问题和程序反馈不足的限制。
我们引入了MMSearch-OPD,将可控制数据的完善与联合强化学习(RL)和政策上分馏(OPD)相结合. 我们的完善管道有针对性地扩大现有简单多式联运问题的推理链。 参数化转换控制搜索深度和跨模式证据要求,同时再用已存在的图像-问题对. 对于培训,回答奖励和轻量级行为处罚指导RL,而奖励差距则会将象征级的老师指导用于不完善的学生轨迹. 随着培训的进行,指数式衰减的分馏系数降低了教师的依赖性。
实验显示,在SFT之后,数据改进和联合培训的进一步改进有所收获,表明长视多式深度搜索能力更强。

blocks.en:
Multimodal deep search agents address knowledge-intensive visual questions
through interleaved reasoning and external retrieval ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Geng et al., 2025 ) . Recent advances move toward
long-horizon investigation, connecting evidence across webpages
and using acquired visual observations to guide subsequent searches ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .

blocks.en:
Two challenges limit training for this setting. Existing multimodal
datasets contain many questions solvable through parametric knowledge or
short retrieval, while constructing harder questions through graph
composition and visual enrichment entails relation collection,
image curation, and evidence validation ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Chu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
Reusing existing image–question pairs offers a starting point for
constructing questions with greater search demands.
Meanwhile, useful long-horizon investigation may end in redundant
verification, premature stopping, or an incorrect answer. Terminal
rewards provide limited process feedback, and trajectory-level
advantages supply a shared scalar signal throughout a rollout ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Identical returns also remove
group-relative learning contrast. Process rewards and teacher
guidance address these limitations ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) ; we combine outcome-based
optimization with selective token-level teacher guidance.

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose MMSearch-OPD ,
combining controllable question refinement with
joint reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD).
Our Refine pipeline reuses simple multimodal questions and their
candidate reasoning chains. Expand extends chain depth, Blur increases
disambiguation requirements, and Visualize introduces
retrievable visual evidence. These configurable operators control
the intended evidence requirements while reusing seed assets
(Figure 1 ). After question
validation and supervised initialization, joint training combines
answer rewards and behavior penalties with token-level OPD on
imperfect student trajectories. The shaped reward gap adjusts
guidance strength, while an exponential schedule reduces the OPD
coefficient as training proceeds.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce Refine, a pipeline that reuses existing
multimodal questions and adjusts their evidence requirements
through chain expansion, entity disambiguation, and visual
evidence requirements. • We develop joint RL and selective OPD training that combines
answer rewards and behavior penalties with reward-gap-weighted
token guidance and exponential annealing on imperfect
long-horizon search trajectories. • We organize evaluation across ten multimodal search
benchmarks to assess agent performance and the roles of data
refinement and joint training.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
MMSearch-R1 and WebWatcher train multimodal agents to interleave
reasoning with external retrieval ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Geng et al., 2025 ) .
Recent work extends search horizons and manages growing interaction
histories ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
DeepVoyager-VL uses intermediate visual evidence to guide subsequent
search ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
These developments call for training questions requiring sustained,
cross-modal evidence acquisition.

blocks.en:
Questions solvable through parametric knowledge or short retrieval
provide limited supervision for long-horizon search. Existing
pipelines increase difficulty through multi-hop composition and
entity obfuscation ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) ,
graph-structured synthesis ( Chu et al., 2026 ; Mei et al., 2026 ) , and
visual evidence
integration ( Zhang et al., 2026c ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
These constructions require evidence collection and validation.
Our Refine pipeline reuses existing easy questions and candidate
reasoning chains, applying Expand, Blur, and Visualize to control
chain length, disambiguation, and visual requirements without
building a large graph from scratch.

blocks.en:
GRPO-based training improves search policies through interaction ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , but terminal scores
offer limited feedback on partially useful trajectories.
Process rewards, adaptive sampling, and finer credit assignment
address this limitation ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Dai et al., 2026 ; Jiao et al., 2026 ; Mei et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
HyperEyes combines efficiency rewards with teacher distillation
on failed rollouts ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Our joint optimization
combines answer rewards and behavior penalties with reward-gap-weighted
teacher guidance on imperfect student trajectories, using exponential
annealing to reduce reliance on the SFT teacher during training.

checks approximate Equation 1 and help ensure
that the added requirements in Equation 8 are
non-trivial.

blocks.en:
We discard questions answered correctly by a direct-answer probe
without tools. An expert model then performs k k tool-augmented
rollouts per question using the training search-and-vision interface.
The probe removes residual parametric shortcuts that refinement alone
cannot rule out, while tool-augmented rollouts test whether the
questions are learnable through external evidence acquisition.
The expert’s empirical Pass@ k k measures agent difficulty, complementing the
chain-based evidence burden D Refined D_{\mathrm{Refined}} .
We retain successful trajectories as SFT demonstrations, sampling
across Pass@ k k levels to balance difficulty and prevent easy
questions from dominating supervision. These estimates also guide
the SFT/RL split described in Section 3.4 .

premature stopping, or an unsupported answer. Final-answer scores
provide limited feedback on these intermediate decisions, motivating
guidance along the search process.
We combine outcome-based policy optimization with token-level

the shared scalar feedback from trajectory-wide advantages.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We use Seed2.1-Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to generate SFT
trajectories. Qwen3.5-27B is fine-tuned on all curated trajectories
and frozen as the OPD teacher. Qwen3.5-9B receives SFT on a
subset, followed by joint RL–OPD
training on harder questions. We report its SFT and RL checkpoints.

我们使用种子2.1-Pro(字节种子,2026年)生成 SFT
轨相. Quen3.5-27B 精细地调整了所有曲轴
并冻为OPD老师。 Quen3.5-9B 接收 SFT a
子集,然后是联合RL-OPD
培训更难的问题。 我们报告它的SFT和RL检查站。

blocks.en:
We evaluate on MMSearch ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , LiveVQA ( Fu et al., 2025 ) ,
BrowseComp-VL ( Geng et al., 2025 ) , MM-BrowseComp ( Li et al., 2025 ) ,
MMSearch-Plus ( Tao et al., 2026 ) , BrowseComp-V 3 ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) ,
and VisBrowse-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) .
We use Qwen3.6-35B-A3B to judge final-answer correctness with the
Vision-DeepResearch judge prompt ( Huang et al., 2026 ) .
Each prediction is judged three times, and the scores are averaged.
Avg. is the unweighted benchmark mean.

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows that MMSearch-OPD-9B reaches
60.2 average accuracy, improving over the corresponding Qwen3.5-9B
agentic workflow by 15.3 points. It achieves the highest reported
accuracy among the compared 7B–9B search agents on all seven
benchmarks, exceeding DeepVoyager-VL-8B by 9.6 points on average.
The 27B SFT teacher reaches 63.2, a 6.5-point improvement over its
agentic-workflow baseline. The trained 9B student also exceeds the
untuned 27B workflow by 3.5 points on average.

blocks.en:
MMSearch-OPD improves performance across the evaluated search
settings, gaining 12.8 points on average over the same 9B agentic
workflow on MMSearch, LiveVQA, and BrowseComp-VL.
In particular, it gains 17.2 points on average on MM-BrowseComp,
MMSearch-Plus, BrowseComp-V 3 , and VisBrowse-Bench,
which place substantial demands on long-horizon investigation and
cross-modal evidence integration. These results demonstrate
substantial improvements in search settings requiring sustained
evidence acquisition and joint reasoning over text and images.

设置, 在同一 9B 代理设备上平均获得12.8分
MMSearch, LiveVQA上的工作流程并浏览Comp-VL.
特别是,在MM-BrowseComp中,平均增长17.2分。
MMSearch-Plus,浏览器Comp-V 3 和 VisBrowse-Bench,
给长期调查带来巨大要求
跨模式证据整合。 这些结果表明:
需要持续地改进搜索环境
获取证据和对文本和图像的共同推理。

blocks.en:
The 9B SFT checkpoint already improves average accuracy from
44.9 to 57.9. Subsequent joint RL–OPD training, labeled RL in
Table 1 , further raises it to 60.2, with
improvements on every benchmark. The 2.3-point average gain
supports joint online optimization after SFT.

Visualize, synthesizing a question from each intermediate structure.
Seed2.1-Pro solves all four versions under identical rollout
settings. Figure 5 reports accuracy,
search length, and tool-use composition. Each search request within
a batched action counts as one tool call.

blocks.en:
Each step strengthens the questions’ search requirements:
accuracy decreases from 79% to 65%, 44%, and 33%.
Expand lowers accuracy with little change in interaction length;
Blur increases average turns from 10.2 to 15.1, consistent with
additional entity disambiguation. Visualize further raises turns
to 20.2 and tool calls to 34.7 per question, while ImageSearch and
FetchImage’s combined share of tool actions increases from 6.3%
to 47.5%. These results support the complementary roles of chain
expansion, disambiguation, and visual evidence acquisition in
constructing harder long-horizon multimodal search tasks.

blocks.zh: 4.4 RL 培训分析

blocks.en:
Figure 5 (a) shows mean answer reward
before behavior penalties rising from 0.347 to 0.587 over 19 steps.
Despite batch fluctuations, this trend indicates improved answer
quality during joint RL–OPD training.

blocks.en:
Search trajectories initially lengthen and then contract
(Figure 5 (b)). Comparing steps 6–13
with steps 14–19, average tool calls decrease from 26.0 to 21.3
(18.3%), and generated response length falls from 29.0k to 23.4k
tokens (19.5%), while mean answer reward remains comparable
(0.525 versus 0.544). These observations are consistent with
increasingly economical search: later rollouts use fewer
interactions and generated tokens without a corresponding decline
in average answer quality. These batch-level trends describe the
joint training run rather than isolate the effect of individual
components.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced MMSearch-OPD, combining controllable data refinement
with joint RL–OPD training for long-horizon multimodal deep search.
Refine reuses existing multimodal question–image pairs and applies targeted
transformations to control search depth, entity disambiguation,
and visual evidence requirements. Joint training complements
answer rewards and behavior penalties with reward-conditioned
token-level guidance on imperfect student trajectories, while
progressively reducing teacher influence. Across seven primary
benchmarks, our 9B agent improves average accuracy by 15.3
percentage points over its agentic-workflow baseline, with joint
training adding 2.3 points beyond SFT. Data ablations further
support the training value of refined questions. Together, these
results show the value of upgrading existing multimodal data to
require sustained evidence acquisition. They also support joint
outcome optimization and selective teacher guidance for learning
long-horizon search and reasoning over text and images.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Refine increases evidence requirements along designated reasoning
chains, but filtering cannot rule out all shortcuts from parametric
knowledge or alternative web evidence. Training depends on teacher
and answer-judge quality, which may introduce noisy guidance.
Open-web search also relies on changing content and tool
availability, limiting reproducibility.

和裁判的品德,这或许导人于正道。
开放网络搜索还依赖于改变内容和工具
可提供性,限制可复制性。
